links.outcome: Time high-scoring patient messages sit unread, pre-post difference-in-difference
links.effect: Improvement beyond trend of 21 minutes in time high-scoring messages sit unread (63 vs 42 minutes for messages sent outside business hours).
links.quote: In a pre-post analysis (n = 396 466), an improvement exceeding the trend was observed in the time high-scoring messages sit unread (21 minutes, 63 vs 42 for messages sent outside business hours).

screen.reason: The study deployed a BERT-based NLP model into live EHR message pools managed by nurses and evaluated its impact on message review turnaround times using a difference-in-differences design.

primary.practice: AI-based message prioritization / triage workflow integration
